title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta31

## Positional custom schedule queue safety

This beta fixes a managed Schedule custom-order bug where a zone could be started again in the same round after scheduler ownership metadata was lost during a handoff or retained-task transition.

### Custom order is now slot-based

- Treat the custom queue as positional slots rather than only a set of zone IDs.
- Preserve intentional duplicate zones, so a queue such as `[36, 37, 36]` still executes all three entries in order.
- Track `started_queue_slots` separately from `completed_queue_slots`.
- Once a slot has been confirmed started, the scheduler will not issue a new `reset=true` command for that same slot within the round.

### Safer ownership-loss behavior

- If an already-started slot loses verifiable retained-task ownership, fail closed with `queue_slot_ownership_unverified` instead of restarting that slot from zero.
- Retained work may still be resumed or continued when ownership is safely proven.
- Prevents the field failure where a `[Yard2, Street2]` queue returned to Yard2 again instead of advancing to Street2.

### Stable per-round queue snapshot

- Persist an immutable `round_queue` snapshot for the active round.
- Schedule editor changes made after a round has started are staged for the next round instead of changing slot identity mid-round.
- Apply the newest configured queue before the first dispatch of a new daily window or continuous-mode round.

### Regression coverage

- Add tests for positional slot tracking, duplicate-zone queues, already-started slot protection, staged editor changes, round-boundary snapshot refresh and scheduler extension install order.
